Hook.name: avatar_load
Hook.Timing: When the framework creates an avatar at this host from a loaded record.
Hook.Error: Load failed: no avatar is published and entry is refused with the cause.

Hook.name: avatar_enter
Hook.Timing: A session attaches to an active avatar.
Hook.Error: Entry refused with an explicit reason.

Hook.name: avatar_tick
Hook.Timing: Node tick, active and visiting avatars only.
Hook.Error: Logged; the avatar stays (matches tick semantics).

Hook.name: avatar_save
Hook.Timing: The single forced-save entry, and the final flush of an ordered close.
Hook.Error: Save failed: surfaced to the operator; retry belongs to the sender queue, not the hook.

Hook.name: avatar_transfer_out
Hook.Error: Transfer aborted; the avatar returns to active (home host) or visiting (cross host).

Hook.name: avatar_transfer_in
Hook.Error: The incoming avatar closes on this host; the source keeps its avatar.

Hook.name: avatar_detach
Hook.Error: Logged; the avatar goes suspended regardless.

Hook.name: avatar_fail
Hook.states: loading active suspended reconnecting transferring visiting closing
Hook.Timing: Any avatar hook failed or timed out.
Hook.Error: Best effort: it may not run during a VM replacement.

Hook.name: onEnterWorld
Hook.Timing: The avatar publishes to the interest layer for a scene it has entered.
Hook.Error: Logged; presence is still published so a hook cannot hide an entity.

Hook.name: onEnterAOI
Hook.Timing: An interest edge appears, fired on both sides of the edge.
Hook.Error: Logged; the interest set is authoritative, not the hook's verdict.

Hook.name: onLeaveAOI
Hook.Timing: An interest edge disappears, fired on both sides, and at destroy.
Hook.Error: Logged; the leave is recorded on the interest layer either way.

Hook.name: onDailyReset
Hook.Timing: Once per day, when the process crosses its configured day boundary, strictly before every onAvatarDailyReset.
Hook.Error: Aborts the node-level reset for the day; no avatar is touched.

Hook.name: onAvatarDailyReset
Hook.Timing: Per resettable avatar at the boundary, or at the end of its suspension window.
Hook.Error: That avatar's reset is deferred to after the barrier; never double-run for one day.

Hook.name: onCrossVisitAdmit
Hook.Timing: Once per join attempt, after the quota gates, before lease acquisition.
Hook.Error: An error answers reject(INVALID); never a silent allow.

Hook.name: onCrossVisitStart
Hook.Timing: After onCrossVisitAdmit allowed, and after avatar_transfer_in at this host.
Hook.Error: Aborts the visit: the lease is relinquished and the join is refused.

Hook.name: onCrossVisitEnd
Hook.Timing: Exactly once per started visit, after the final flush decision.

Hook.name: onLeaseTaken
Hook.Timing: Before any durable write under the new generation, and before onCrossVisitStart.
Hook.Error: Relinquishes the lease and aborts the visit.

Hook.name: onLeaseLost
Hook.Timing: After the last durable write under the old generation, and before any onLeaseTaken for a newer generation at this host.
